response.text: Consumer fireworks may be discharged in the City only on Victoria Day or Canada Day (or the next day before or after, if weather makes it impractical or unsafe), and not after 11:00 p.m. on those days [2]. On other days you need a special occasions fireworks discharge permit issued by the Fire Chief, and it may only be used on the date, time and location in the permit [3]. Discharge is also not allowed on land you don't own without the owner's written consent [2]. The passages do not address whether a backyard is covered by any additional rules beyond these.

Consumer fireworks may be discharged in the City only on Victoria Day or Canada Day (or the next day before or after, if weather makes it impractical or unsafe), or on a day for which a special occasions fireworks discharge permit has been issued by the Fire Chief [2][3]. On Victoria Day or Canada Day, discharge must stop by 11:00 p.m. [2]. Discharge on private land is allowed only on land you own or with the owner's prior written consent, and you may not discharge fireworks within 100 metres of explosives, gasoline or other highly flammable substances, or in a manner that creates a nuisance or unsafe condition [2]. You must also keep fully operational fire extinguishing equipment at the site while discharging [2]. The passages do not state the permit application details for your specific property beyond these conditions.

Consumer fireworks may be discharged in the City only on Victoria Day or Canada Day, or on a date covered by a special occasions fireworks discharge permit issued by the Fire Chief [2]. On those days, discharge is not allowed after 11:00 p.m., and if weather makes it impractical or unsafe, the next day before or after the designated day applies [2]. You also cannot discharge consumer fireworks on land you do not own without the owner's prior written consent [2], and a special occasions permit requires an application, a fee and indemnity agreement [3]. Fireworks may not be discharged within 100 metres of certain institutions such as schools, hospitals and religious institutions unless the institution's owner consents [3]. The passages do not cover the rules for a backyard on days outside these permitted dates or whether a special permit is granted in a given case.
